name: Zerion
tagline: Wallet portfolio, DeFi positions, and transaction history API across many chains.
description: Zerion API provides multi-chain wallet portfolio data, DeFi positions, transaction history, and related crypto data for developers building wallet and DeFi applications.

auth.details: API key authentication required; details to be verified from official docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer plan: 2,000 requests per day and 3 requests per second. DeFi Positions, Wallet Portfolio Chart, and Wallet P&L endpoints are capped at 25% of the plan quota and are not covered by overages.

rate_limits: Plan-based: Developer 3 RPS, Builder 10 RPS, Startup 25 RPS, and Enterprise 1,000+ RPS. Their quotas are 2,000/day, 250,000/month, 1,000,000/month, and 2,500,000+/month, respectively. Responses include limit, remaining-quota, and reset headers.
use_cases: get wallet portfolio balances across chains
list DeFi positions for an address
fetch transaction history for a wallet
